title: WHO: people older than 10 should aim for at least 400 grams of fruit and vegetables a day
summary: The healthy-diet sheet sets 400 grams for people older than 10, and lower amounts for younger children.
body: WHO's healthy-diet fact sheet says everyone older than 10 should aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day, with lesser amounts for children under 10: at least 250 grams for ages 2 to 5, or 350 grams for ages 6 to 9. It also says everyone older than 10 should aim for at least 25 grams a day of naturally occurring dietary fibre, with 15 or 21 grams for those younger child groups. The amounts are the sheet's targets.
